description_en:
The human skills AI can't do — learned between two work cultures.

Sena works in Tokyo. Daniel manages a team in Seattle. Human Curriculum is an audio drama about the skills that matter more as AI gets smarter: emotional intelligence (EQ), trust, feedback, influence, and speaking up at work.

In every episode, Sena brings a real problem from work, Daniel brings the research and an honest story from his own career, and they compare how the same moment plays out in Tokyo and in Seattle. You leave with one small challenge to try at work today.

🎧 New episodes every day, about 15 minutes each
🇯🇵🇺🇸 Japan vs US: the work-culture differences nobody explains
📖 Real research, explained simply
✅ One challenge to try at work today
💬 Captions in English and Japanese

For professionals who want to communicate better, lead with EQ, or work across cultures.

Start with Episode 1 and grow with Sena, one episode at a time.

Sena and Daniel are fictional characters. Their voices are AI-generated.
description_ja:
AIにできない「人の力」を、ふたつの働き方の文化のあいだで。

東京で働くセナと、シアトルでチームを率いるダニエル。Human Curriculum は、AIが賢くなるほど大切になる力――EQ（心の知能）、信頼、フィードバック、影響力、意見を言う力――を描くオーディオドラマです。

毎回、セナが持ってくる仕事の悩みに、ダニエルが研究と自分の失敗談で答えます。同じ場面が日本の職場とアメリカの職場でどう違うのかも具体的に。最後に、今日すぐ職場で試せるチャレンジを1つ。

🎧 毎日新しいエピソード（1話約15分）
🇯🇵🇺🇸 日本とアメリカ、働き方の文化の違い
📖 研究をやさしく解説
✅ 今日職場で試せるチャレンジ1つ
💬 英語・日本語の字幕つき

伝え方を磨きたい人、EQで人を動かしたい人、文化をこえて働く人へ。

第1話から順番に、セナと一緒に少しずつ成長していきましょう。

※セナとダニエルは架空の人物で、声はAIです。
